children: Sunteck Realty Ltd has reported a 17 per cent increase in its consolidated net profit to ₹57.11 crore in the quarter ended September on higher income.
Its net profit stood at ₹48.96 crore in the year-ago period.

Total income rose 27 per cent to ₹333.82 crore during the July-September quarter of 2026-27 fiscal from ₹262.16 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing on Monday.
In the first half of this fiscal, the company's net profit rose to ₹99.07 crore from ₹82.39 crore in the year-ago period.
During the April-September period of 2026-27, the company's total income grew to ₹535.85 crore from ₹463.69 crore in the year-ago period.
On the operational front, Sunteck Realty reported that its pre-sales grew 17 per cent to ₹824 crore in the September quarter and 19 per cent in the first six months to ₹1,611 crore.
Mumbai-based Sunteck Realty is one of the leading real estate developers in the country. It has a portfolio of over 50 million sq ft area across 32 projects.

title: Sunteck Realty Q2 profit rises 17% to ₹57 cr; income grows 27% to ₹334 cr
